name: Password Cracking and Hashing Algorithms
tagline: A Python internship project exploring password hashing, salting, and password-cracking concepts with examples and tests.
description: Developed during an internship with Codec Technologies, this project demonstrates password hashing with and without salting and introduces dictionary-based and brute-force password-cracking concepts. The codebase is organized into modular source files, runnable example scripts, documentation, and unit tests.
problemStatement: Demonstrate password-hashing and password-security concepts through a modular Python project, including salting and introductory password-cracking methods.
solution: A Python project featuring MD5, SHA-256, SHA-512, and bcrypt hashing examples, salting utilities, and demonstrations of dictionary-based and brute-force password-cracking concepts, supported by unit tests.

features.name: Salting
features.details: Demonstrates salted hashing to help mitigate rainbow-table attacks.

features.name: Example scripts
features.details: Runnable demos for hashing, salting, and password-cracking concepts.

features.name: Unit tests
features.details: Tests are included to verify hashing and cracking functions.

features.name: Modular codebase
features.details: Separates hash functions, salting, password-cracking logic, and helper utilities.

components.name: Password cracker
components.description: Demonstrates brute-force and dictionary attack concepts.

testing.details: The README states that unit tests are included to verify hashing and password-cracking functions.
